answer: The reveal must open the same atlas hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the karst gate. Copying becomes a race the farming party always loses, and producing 75 original texts is the only way to fill 65 aliases; the cedar log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
